benefit_text: The scheme pays 1,20,000 rupees per house in plain areas. It pays 1,30,000 rupees per house in hilly areas and difficult areas. It also pays up to 12,000 rupees for toilets. Houses are at least 25 sq m with space for clean cooking.
who_can_apply: Houseless households and households in zero, one or two room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs can apply. Priority is for households without shelter, destitute households, manual scavengers, primitive tribal groups and released bonded laborers. Gram Sabhas verify the list from SECC 2011.
documents: People need Aadhaar number and Aadhaar card copy. People need MGNREGA job card and bank account details. People also need an affidavit saying the family owns no pucca house.
how_to_apply: People can register on the official PMAY-G website. People fill personal details, bank details, MGNREGA job card number and SBM number. The concerned office fills the last section.
